Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kaisharga wrote:
> Hi fellas. I'm a new member in this group and I wanted to say hi.

Howdy.

> Also, If i treat aggravated damage as normal before range is
> determined can the opposing player play rotshreck? I know you have
> exhausted this matter , bout until now I can't find an answer to my
> question.

Yes, any player (not just the controller of the opposing minion) can
play Rötschreck when a minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage
on an opposing minion in combat. It does not matter if the opposing
vampire will/could prevent the damage or treat the damage a certain
way or ignore (be immune to) the damage.

The Methuselah whose turn it is cannot play Rötschreck, since it is
an out-of-turn master, though.
